events.title: Giovanni de' Medici proclaimed Pope Leo X
events.description: The son of Lorenzo the Magnificent was announced as pope at 37. A lavish patron of Raphael and others, he promoted the indulgence campaign for St Peter's that provoked Martin Luther in 1517.
events.html: The son of Lorenzo the Magnificent was announced as pope at 37. A lavish patron of Raphael and others, he promoted the indulgence campaign for St Peter's that provoked Martin Luther in 1517.

events.title: The Daily Courant, Britain's first daily newspaper, appears
events.description: Published by Elizabeth Mallet near Fleet Street, the single-sheet Courant carried foreign news translated from continental papers. It ran until 1735, founding the British daily press.

events.title: Luddite machine-breaking begins in Nottinghamshire
events.description: After a protest in Nottingham was dispersed, framework knitters broke dozens of stocking frames at Arnold. Attacks on machinery spread across the Midlands and North under the name of 'Ned Ludd'.
events.html: After a protest in Nottingham was dispersed, framework knitters broke dozens of stocking frames at Arnold. Attacks on machinery spread across the Midlands and North under the name of 'Ned Ludd'.

events.title: Verdi's 'Rigoletto' premieres in Venice
events.description: The opera of a hunchbacked jester was a triumph at La Fenice. Verdi reportedly kept the aria 'La donna è mobile' secret until the final rehearsals, and it was soon sung in the streets.
events.html: The opera of a hunchbacked jester was a triumph at La Fenice. Verdi reportedly kept the aria 'La donna è mobile' secret until the final rehearsals, and it was soon sung in the streets.

events.title: British and Indian troops capture Baghdad
events.description: General Stanley Maude's army entered Baghdad after the Ottoman garrison withdrew, avenging the surrender at Kut a year earlier. Britain went on to rule Mesopotamia, later Iraq, under a League mandate.

events.title: Roosevelt signs the Lend-Lease Act
events.description: The act allowed the United States to lend or lease war supplies to nations whose defence was vital to America. Britain, the Soviet Union and China received some 50 billion dollars of aid.

events.title: Mikhail Gorbachev becomes Soviet leader
events.description: The 54-year-old Gorbachev was chosen General Secretary the day after Konstantin Chernenko's death. His policies of glasnost and perestroika unleashed forces that ended the Soviet Union in 1991.
events.html: The 54-year-old Gorbachev was chosen General Secretary the day after Konstantin Chernenko's death. His policies of glasnost and perestroika unleashed forces that ended the Soviet Union in 1991.

events.title: WHO declares COVID-19 a pandemic
events.description: The World Health Organization described the coronavirus outbreak as a pandemic, with cases in over 100 countries. Lockdowns followed worldwide, and millions died in the years that followed.
